summary: The righteous praise and thank the God of Jacob—They will be exalted—God is the judge, and the wicked will be condemned.
meta_description: The righteous praise and thank the God of Jacob—They will be exalted—God is the judge, and the wicked will be condemned.
section_headings: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, A Psalm or Song of Asaph.
